scope: Theorem 8.3 (The exact visible operator) of the manuscript “Cutoff throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase” (preprints/Cutoff-throughout-the-high-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-phase-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d99d391c8c3ed79f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 84. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The spaces in Theorem 8.2 and their semigroups are deterministic. The embedding ι : X → Xv is continuous, injective, and dense. On Xv, Kt is a positive self-adjoint semigroup. If Av is minus its generator, then spec(Av) ⊂ [γ, ∞) for the fixed gap constant γ > 0 in Theorem 2.1. In particular the number λ = min {λsp, inf spec(Av)} satisfies 0 < λ ≤ λsp ≤ (1 − β)2 . (8.6) All dimension limits in this definition precede the spectral infimum.
